issues.description: OutputImageRawFrame uses raw bytes from a PIL image that may not be RGB
issues.detail: image.tobytes() returns raw pixel bytes in whatever mode the decoded image uses (e.g. RGBA for PNG with alpha, P for palette). The frame is hard-coded as format='RGB', so downstream renderers will misinterpret bytes-per-pixel and either crash or display garbled output. Call image.convert('RGB') before tobytes().

issues.description: Module-level mutation of genai private API on import
issues.detail: Setting `genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024` at import time mutates a private attribute of a third-party library globally, affecting every genai user in the process (not just this service). The comment admits it's a hack. This will silently break on google-genai upgrades that rename/remove the attribute and should at minimum be guarded with hasattr and scoped per-client if possible.

issues.description: Default model change is a breaking behavior change buried in a feature PR
issues.detail: Changing the default `GoogleLLMService` model from `gemini-2.0-flash` to `gemini-2.5-flash` will silently alter latency, cost, and output for every existing user who didn't pin a model. This deserves a more prominent migration note than a one-line CHANGELOG entry, and arguably belongs in a separate PR.

issues.description: Image detection via substring match is fragile
issues.detail: `if "image" in self._model_name` will match any future model name containing 'image' anywhere (e.g. 'gemini-3-image-preview', 'imagen-foo'), which may not all be Nano Banana-style models that should skip thinking budgets. Prefer an explicit allowlist or a more precise check like endswith('-image') or startswith('gemini-2.5-flash-image').

issues.description: No error handling around PIL image decode
issues.detail: `Image.open(io.BytesIO(part.inline_data.data))` can raise UnidentifiedImageError or other PIL exceptions if Gemini returns unexpected/corrupt data, which will bubble up and kill the whole _process_context loop mid-response. Wrap in try/except and log instead of letting one bad part abort the conversation turn.

issues.description: Example file's CHANGELOG entry calls it 'Nano Banana' but code/comment terminology is inconsistent
issues.detail: The CHANGELOG markets the feature as 'Nano Banana models' but the example file, docstrings, and code comments don't use that name except in one internal hack comment. Users searching for 'image generation' or 'gemini-2.5-flash-image' may not find the CHANGELOG entry. Consider aligning terminology.

review.summary: The PR adds Gemini image generation support but has two notable correctness issues: the OutputImageRawFrame is constructed with `image.tobytes()` and a hard-coded 'RGB' format without converting modes (will break for RGBA/P-mode outputs), and a third-party private attribute is mutated globally at import time as an admitted hack. The default model bump from 2.0 to 2.5 is a behavior change worth surfacing more prominently. Smaller issues: substring-based image-model detection is fragile, PIL decode lacks error handling, and naming/terminology is inconsistent across CHANGELOG and code.
